answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the beacon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The harbor is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the yarrow. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
